name: instance_who_am_i_proto
about: A structured-reason error: `unimplemented` carrying an ErrorInfo whose reason is `not_implemented`, because this build has no authentication yet. An SDK branches on the reason, never on the message. (The binary encoding, which is what an SDK sends by default.)

body.message: loams.instance.v1.InstanceService/WhoAmI is not implemented by this build yet
